companies.description:
Role Overview We are seeking exceptional early-career software engineers who aspire to build the next generation of AI-native software platforms, reusable software IP and intelligent enterprise solutions. As an Elite Technology Engineer you will combine strong full-stack engineering foundations with AI-first development practices to create production-grade software, domain-specific AI capabilities and reusable engineering assets that power the future of enterprise technology. You will work on real client programmes across industries, designing and delivering AI-native applications using modern cloud platforms, AI-assisted development tools and software engineering best practices. Working alongside architects, product teams and AI specialists, you will help shape intelligent, scalable and continuously evolving software solutions. This role provides accelerated learning through structured AI certification pathways, exposure to leading AI ecosystems and hands-on experience developing reusable AI capabilities that create long-term client value.

companies.description:
Digital Consultants help clients solve business challenges through technology and enable large-scale digital transformation initiatives. Working with organizations across various industries, digital consultants design, architect, and deliver technology-driven solutions that create measurable business value. As a Digital Consultant, you will: - Diagnose client business challenges and design enterprise architecture and digital solutions that deliver measurable outcomes - Lead the selection and design of cutting-edge technology solutions — Cloud, AI/Data Analytics, Industry X (Manufacturing Digitalization), IoT, XR, Customer Experience, and more — tailored to each client's strategic priorities - Translate complex technology possibilities into actionable business strategies, guiding clients from vision through to execution - Define what should be built — not just how to build it — leveraging AI and automation to enhance quality and accelerate delivery - Drive the full consulting lifecycle: problem diagnosis, solution design, implementation oversight, and value realization What sets Accenture apart: We are technology-agnostic, enabling us to always recommend the best solution for our clients — unconstrained by proprietary products. Our goal is not to ""build for the sake of building,"" but to ""transform and deliver results." You will start your career as an Analyst, developing both technology and consulting skills through hands-on project experience. As you gain experience, you can progress to Consultant and Manager and pursue a variety of career paths based on your interests, strengths, experience, and skills, including: Business × Technology Path: Leverage your engineering experience to expand into upstream areas such as requirements definition, IT planning and strategy, and solution design and proposals. Project Management Path: Develop your project management expertise and grow into a role that leads teams, large-scale projects, and programs. Technology Specialist Path: Deepen your expertise in specific technology areas and grow into roles such as a technology specialist or architect, leading projects from a technical perspective. Your career is not limited to a single path. As business demands evolve, you will have the opportunity to develop new skills and expand your areas of expertise — building a career that grows with both your strengths and the needs of your clients.

PLACEMENT	Digital Consultant	8214021 JPY
Job Description
Digital Consultants help clients solve business challenges through technology and enable large-scale digital transformation initiatives. Working with organizations across various industries, digital consultants design, architect, and deliver technology-driven solutions that create measurable business value. As a Digital Consultant, you will: - Diagnose client business challenges and design enterprise architecture and digital solutions that deliver measurable outcomes - Lead the selection and design of cutting-edge technology solutions — Cloud, AI/Data Analytics, Industry X (Manufacturing Digitalization), IoT, XR, Customer Experience, and more — tailored to each client's strategic priorities - Translate complex technology possibilities into actionable business strategies, guiding clients from vision through to execution - Define what should be built — not just how to build it — leveraging AI and automation to enhance quality and accelerate delivery - Drive the full consulting lifecycle: problem diagnosis, solution design, implementation oversight, and value realization What sets Accenture apart: We are technology-agnostic, enabling us to always recommend the best solution for our clients — unconstrained by proprietary products. Our goal is not to ""build for the sake of building,"" but to ""transform and deliver results." You will start your career as an Analyst, developing both technology and consulting skills through hands-on project experience. As you gain experience, you can progress to Consultant and Manager and pursue a variety of career paths based on your interests, strengths, experience, and skills, including: Business × Technology Path: Leverage your engineering experience to expand into upstream areas such as requirements definition, IT planning and strategy, and solution design and proposals. Project Management Path: Develop your project management expertise and grow into a role that leads teams, large-scale projects, and programs. Technology Specialist Path: Deepen your expertise in specific technology areas and grow into roles such as a technology specialist or architect, leading projects from a technical perspective. Your career is not limited to a single path. As business demands evolve, you will have the opportunity to develop new skills and expand your areas of expertise — building a career that grows with both your strengths and the needs of your clients.

About the role: As a graduate in Deutsche Bank, you will have the opportunity to work with teams supporting the Bank's Investment Banking business globally and learn about banking from different viewpoints, which will give you a career advantage. As a graduate, your work may include: Connecting and working with global teams within the Investment Bank, and interacting with bankers, traders, and structurers in different regions across the world. Developing a strong grasp of ongoing macro events and their impact on various asset classes. Undertaking in-depth analysis of companies, sectors, and transactions, including due diligence and financial modelling of companies, industry analysis, quantitative and technical analysis, benchmarking, or supporting the execution of deals and flow trades. Developing a holistic view of the business, including the DB product suite, its operational markets, and applicable regulations. Based on this, creating marketing content related to deal pitches, new trades executed, DB capability expansion, regulatory changes, etc. Areas in which you can work: Origination & Advisory Industry Coverage (e.g., Industrials, Healthcare, TMT, etc.) Product Coverage (e.g., M&A, Ratings Advisory, Equity & Debt Capital Markets, etc.) What we look for: We recruit graduates who are intelligent and adaptable, with excellent interpersonal skills. They have degrees in many different disciplines. Even though good levels of numeracy are important for some roles, you will not necessarily need a formal mathematical or financial background. We have very comprehensive training programmes that will give you all the technical knowledge you'll need to build a career with us. To be eligible for the 2026 Graduate Programme, you must: Complete your studies (all final exams and coursework) and have no outstanding requirements for graduation by July 2026. Be able to start full-time work in July 2026, subject to local working legislation and visa requirements.

Job Description
About the role: As a graduate in Deutsche Bank, you will have the opportunity to work with teams supporting the Bank's Investment Banking business globally and learn about banking from different viewpoints, which will give you a career advantage. As a graduate, your work may include: Connecting and working with global teams within the Investment Bank, and interacting with bankers, traders, and structurers in different regions across the world. Developing a strong grasp of ongoing macro events and their impact on various asset classes. Undertaking in-depth analysis of companies, sectors, and transactions, including due diligence and financial modelling of companies, industry analysis, quantitative and technical analysis, benchmarking, or supporting the execution of deals and flow trades. Developing a holistic view of the business, including the DB product suite, its operational markets, and applicable regulations. Based on this, creating marketing content related to deal pitches, new trades executed, DB capability expansion, regulatory changes, etc. Areas in which you can work: Origination & Advisory Industry Coverage (e.g., Industrials, Healthcare, TMT, etc.) Product Coverage (e.g., M&A, Ratings Advisory, Equity & Debt Capital Markets, etc.) What we look for: We recruit graduates who are intelligent and adaptable, with excellent interpersonal skills. They have degrees in many different disciplines. Even though good levels of numeracy are important for some roles, you will not necessarily need a formal mathematical or financial background. We have very comprehensive training programmes that will give you all the technical knowledge you'll need to build a career with us. To be eligible for the 2026 Graduate Programme, you must: Complete your studies (all final exams and coursework) and have no outstanding requirements for graduation by July 2026. Be able to start full-time work in July 2026, subject to local working legislation and visa requirements.

Job Description
Software Engineer I – Campus Hiring Role Join Harness as a Software Engineer I and work on building scalable, reliable software across areas such as CI/CD, Cloud, Security, Infrastructure, Developer Experience, and AI-powered software delivery. You will work closely with experienced engineers to design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality software. Eligibility B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/M.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering disciplines. Fresh graduates graduating in 2027. Strong academic and technical fundamentals. Eligible candidates as per the campus-specific placement criteria. Skills Strong understanding of Data Structures & Algorithms. Good knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming. Proficiency in at least one programming language: Java, C++, Go, or Python. Understanding of DBMS, Operating Systems, and Computer Networks. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Good communication and collaboration skills. Familiarity with Git, Linux, REST APIs, cloud technologies, or CI/CD is a plus. Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software. Build scalable and reliable products and services. Write clean, efficient, and well-tested code. Debug and troubleshoot technical issues. Participate in code reviews and engineering discussions. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, QA, and other cross-functional teams. Learn and contribute to Harness technologies, tools, and engineering practices.

companies.description:
Scope: We are seeking top tier Cloud Native DevOps Platform Engineers to augment our Data Platform team. This role requires a breadth of individual technical capabilities and competencies, though, most important, is a willingness and openness to learn new things across multiple technology disciplines. This role is for practitioners and not researchers. Based in Gurugram, you will design, build, and evolve our cloud-native platform that powers high-scale applications and AI infrastructure. You will drive automation, reliability, cost-efficiency, and developer experience across our CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes platforms, observability, and security controls. As a Platform Engineer you will have the opportunity to: Work alongside our system engineers and UI developers to help design and build scalable, automated CI/CD pipelines. Help prove out and productionize infrastructure and tooling to support scalable cloud-based applications. Work/Unlock myriad generative AI/ML use cases for Data Strategy Group and thus for HL. Have fun as part of an awesome team. Responsibilities: Platform Ownership Develop, implement, and operate a robust internal platform (Kubernetes-based) enabling self-service deployments, scalable workloads, and standardized guardrails. Contribute to the development and enhancement of CI/CD workflows and automation solutions using GitLab or GitHub Cloud Engineering Design secure and cost-aware cloud topologies (networking, IAM, compute, storage, serverless, managed DBs, and edge/CDN). Collaborate with the platform engineering team to implement and operate Kubernetes-native capabilities such as service networking, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions. Observability & Reliability Establish end-to-end telemetry with OpenTelemetry; define SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, and incident response runbooks. Developer Experience Improve inner-loop productivity with golden paths, templates, and CLI tooling; champion platform usability and documentation. Data Operations and Engineering Support database or datastores e.g. MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, Ignite, Hadoop, S3, Azure Blob Store; and various messaging and streaming platforms such as NATS or Kafka Gain hands-on experience in developing Python-based solutions for data acquisition, processing, and ETL/ELT workflows. Basic Qualifications & Experience required: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, preferrable computer science. Exposure to cloud technologies through academic projects, internships, certifications, hackathons, or self-learning is preferred. Strong Knowledge in Data Structures, Programming Language preferably Python, Golang. Knowledge of Linux/Unix Operating Systems. Strong communication skills (written & verbal) in English.

Job Description
Scope: We are seeking top tier Cloud Native DevOps Platform Engineers to augment our Data Platform team. This role requires a breadth of individual technical capabilities and competencies, though, most important, is a willingness and openness to learn new things across multiple technology disciplines. This role is for practitioners and not researchers. Based in Gurugram, you will design, build, and evolve our cloud-native platform that powers high-scale applications and AI infrastructure. You will drive automation, reliability, cost-efficiency, and developer experience across our CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes platforms, observability, and security controls. As a Platform Engineer you will have the opportunity to: Work alongside our system engineers and UI developers to help design and build scalable, automated CI/CD pipelines. Help prove out and productionize infrastructure and tooling to support scalable cloud-based applications. Work/Unlock myriad generative AI/ML use cases for Data Strategy Group and thus for HL. Have fun as part of an awesome team. Responsibilities: Platform Ownership Develop, implement, and operate a robust internal platform (Kubernetes-based) enabling self-service deployments, scalable workloads, and standardized guardrails. Contribute to the development and enhancement of CI/CD workflows and automation solutions using GitLab or GitHub Cloud Engineering Design secure and cost-aware cloud topologies (networking, IAM, compute, storage, serverless, managed DBs, and edge/CDN). Collaborate with the platform engineering team to implement and operate Kubernetes-native capabilities such as service networking, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions. Observability & Reliability Establish end-to-end telemetry with OpenTelemetry; define SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, and incident response runbooks. Developer Experience Improve inner-loop productivity with golden paths, templates, and CLI tooling; champion platform usability and documentation. Data Operations and Engineering Support database or datastores e.g. MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, Ignite, Hadoop, S3, Azure Blob Store; and various messaging and streaming platforms such as NATS or Kafka Gain hands-on experience in developing Python-based solutions for data acquisition, processing, and ETL/ELT workflows. Basic Qualifications & Experience required: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, preferrable computer science. Exposure to cloud technologies through academic projects, internships, certifications, hackathons, or self-learning is preferred. Strong Knowledge in Data Structures, Programming Language preferably Python, Golang. Knowledge of Linux/Unix Operating Systems. Strong communication skills (written & verbal) in English.

About the company	InMobi: Building a new company in the recession of 2007 was no ordinary task. Yet with passion and foresight, we charted our course, helping to transform the way consumers engage with their phones. Over the last 17 years, InMobi has built a global Advertising Platform that powers our customers’ growth by helping them engage their audiences and drive real connections. InMobi has also built a second unicorn, Glance, which is advancing digital consumption and creating a new wave of disruption. Present on 400M devices across India, SEA, Japan and the US – Glance is one of the largest content platforms globally with~200M daily active users. Glance: Founded in 2019, Glance is a consumer technology company that operates some of the most disruptive digital platforms including Glance, Roposo, and Glance TV. Glance has redefined the way the internet is consumed on the lock screen, removing the need to search for and download apps. Over 400 million smartphones now come enabled with Glance’s next-generation internet experience.     Roposo has revolutionized commerce by launching a destination for creator-led live entertainment commerce. Glance TV is changing the way consumers engage and interact with their televisions.     Headquartered in Singapore, Glance is an unconsolidated subsidiary of InMobi Group and is funded by Jio Platforms, Google, and Mithril Capital. For more information, visit glance.com, roposo.com, and inmobi.com.

Job Description
About the team: Are you fascinated with building a problem-solving, customer-facing, intuitive, creative tech-products that adds value to their life? Well, if you’ve landed on this page, your answer is most-likely YES. Visionary, cynical, upskilling - a few adjectives to describe our Product team. If you feel the vibe, step 1 is done. About the role: As an Associate Product Manager, you’ll work at the intersection of product, analytics, and execution. You’ll help break down real-world payment problems, turn data into insights, and support the building of simple, intuitive experiences used by millions of young Indians. This role is perfect if you’re excited about learning product craft, using data to guide decisions, and shipping features that create visible impact. What You will do: - Work closely with Product Managers to understand customer problems, business goals, and stakeholder requirements - Turn raw data into sharp insights that shape what gets built next - Strong analytical mindset with comfort working with data, metrics, dashboards, and basic SQL/Excel. - Help write the requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that turn ideas into shipped features - Bring structure to roadmap conversations, blending gut instinct with hard numbers - Work cross-functionally with engineering, design, and analytics to take features from whiteboard to millions of screens - Own the post-launch story - track what worked, what didn't, and why, then use that to make the next version sharper - Develop a deep understanding of how users interact with slice products and where we can make experiences simpler and better What you will need: - Strong first-principles and structured problem-solving ability - you'd rather break a problem down from scratch than reach for a template - Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate ideas crisply - High ownership mindset and comfort operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with minimal hand-holding - Prior internship experience in product management, analytics, consulting, or related roles is a plus - Genuine curiosity about how India spends, saves, and borrows Life at slice Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding: - Competitive salaries. Period. - An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their dependants. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise. - Flexible working hours. Just don’t call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule. - Tailored vacation & leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life. - A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here. - Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding. - Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel at home. An environment so good, you’ll forget the term “colleagues can’t be your friends”. Come join our crew! About slice: slice A new bank for a new India slice’s purpose is to make the world better at using money and time, with a major focus on building the best consumer experience for your money. We’ve all felt how slow, confusing, and complicated banking can be. So, we’re reimagining it. We’re building every product from scratch to be fast, transparent, and feel good, because we believe that the best products transcend demographics, like how great music touches most of us. Our cornerstone products and services: slice savings account, slice UPI credit card, slice UPI, slice UPI ATMs, slice fixed deposits, slice borrow, and UPI-powered bank branch are designed to be simple, rewarding, and completely in your control. At slice, you’ll get to build things you’d use yourself and shape the future of banking in India. We tailor our working experience with the belief that the present moment is the only real thing in life. And we have harmony in the present the most when we feel happy and successful together.

Job Description
About the team Be it huge, medium, small, tiny, micro - every decision falls under the eyes of our Analytics team. Every analysis and insight drawn by the Analytics team directly impacts our business without fail and that's why the team is full of people who make sure the impact’s legen - wait for it - dary - Legendary. If digging into numbers and unlocking insights sounds like your kind of fun, you’ll fit right in. About the role As an Analyst at slice, you’ll turn data into decisions. You’ll work with teams across Product, Growth, Credit, and Leadership to uncover insights, solve real business problems, and drive strategy. If you’re excited about using data to fuel impact at scale, this role is for you. What You will do You'll start with first principles thinking - breaking down problems to their core, using data and analytical reasoning to uncover insights that really move the needle for the business and create a better experience for our customers. You'll get hands-on across the analytics spectrum: Descriptive – building clear, compelling visualizations and dashboards Diagnostic – digging into the why behind trends and performance Prescriptive – turning insights into recommendations that drive smart decisions You’ll work side-by-side with functional leaders and business partners across teams like Growth, Retention, Product, Risk, Engineering, Marketing Fraud, and Ops, asking the right questions, challenging assumptions, and helping define the real business problems worth solving. And most importantly, you’ll turn complex data into simple, actionable stories - crafting solutions that power big decisions and deliver real impact at scale. What you will need Hustle + Heart: You’ve got the drive to build data solutions that touch millions of lives and the curiosity to keep asking “what’s next?” You speak data fluently: Advanced SQL is your second language, and you’re comfortable in Python, R, or Excel when the situation calls for it. Problem-solving at your core: You love breaking big, messy problems into bite-sized pieces - and crafting smart, scalable solutions. Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate ideas crisply High ownership mindset and comfort operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with minimal hand-holding Life at slice Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding: Competitive salaries. Period. An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their dependants. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise. Flexible working hours. Just don’t call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule. Tailored vacation & leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life. A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here. Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding. Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel at home. An environment so good, you’ll forget the term “colleagues can’t be your friends”. Come join our crew! About us slice the way you bank slice’s purpose is to make the world better at using money and time, with a major focus on building the best consumer experience for your money. We’ve all felt how slow, confusing, and complicated banking can be. So, we’re reimagining it. We’re building every product from scratch to be fast, transparent, and feel good, because we believe that the best products transcend demographics, like how great music touches most of us. Our cornerstone products and services: slice savings account, slice UPI credit card, slice UPI, slice UPI ATMs, slice fixed deposits, slice borrow, and UPI-powered bank branch are designed to be simple, rewarding, and completely in your control. At slice, you’ll get to build things you’d use yourself and shape the future of banking in India. We tailor our working experience with the belief that the present moment is the only real thing in life. And we have harmony in the present the most when we feel happy and successful together. We’re backed by some of the world’s leading investors, including Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Advent International, Blume Ventures, and Gunosy Capital.

We are looking for highly motivated graduates or early career professionals with an interest in finance and a background in computer science, engineering, mathematics or other STEM degrees to join our Desk Quant Analyst three-year program. You will spend these three years working in close collaboration with experienced Quantitative Researchers and Traders to understand the constantly evolving needs of the trading desks. | Overview of Desk Quant Analyst Position: • Maintain and upgrade the codebase and configuration of strategies within the firm’s automated trading framework. • Manage large datasets used in both research and production environments. • Perform live as well as historical monitoring of trading activities. For instance, do some post-trade analysis or production reconciliation. • Work in close collaboration with quant researchers and traders to understand the constantly evolving needs of the trading desks. Typical Day of Desk Quant Analyst • Before market open, check that all required data and related processes are ready for the trading day. • During market hours, sporadically monitor behavior and performance of strategies. • Work on various longer-term projects required for expanding our systematic trading activities and ensuring their robustness.

companies.description:
We’re looking for Graduates to kick-start their career in technology with us. We want to invite smart, self-driven, inquisitive people with a strong quantitative or engineering mindset to join us. At Squarepoint, you will work alongside Senior Technologists, in small groups, to design and build the next generation of production grade trading & research software, systems, and infrastructure. Join one of Squarepoint's technology tracks and align your interests to ours. Select the track that best fits your career goals, qualifications, and experience. | Squarepoint Capital is seeking smart, self-driven and inquisitive individuals who want an opportunity to apply their advanced skills and knowledge in a challenging and innovative environment. You will work alongside experienced colleagues, in small groups, to design and build the next generation of production grade trading and research software systems. Step into a career of continuous learning and development, surrounded by some of the most talented individuals in the industry, and grow your skills in a highly collegiate work environment. When applying, you can indicate your preference for one or more of the following tracks. We will however work to ensure your role at Squarepoint is best suited to your skillset. Python Development: Applications, services, and data driven systems: Projects within this track focus on developing and maintaining scalable services, full-stack web applications, and data processing algorithms, tools, and frameworks. • Build and maintain the core tooling, libraries, and frameworks we use for developing applications at Squarepoint, • Manage the software development lifecycle of libraries and frameworks used globally by our teams of technologists, • Contribute to data driven applications, pipelines, and systems used to feed predictive models in research and trading, • Build software products used worldwide by traders, researchers, data scientists, and other teams at Squarepoint to fuel our trading success. C++ Development: Distributed, low latency, high performance systems: Projects within this track focus on developing and maintaining performance sensitive, reliable and scalable back-ends which are critical to our trading infrastructure. • Work on high performance, low-latency systems powering critical trading operations, • Drive the design and implementation of trading frameworks, market data solutions and global market connectivity, • Build massively parallel, high-volume, distributed applications to enable our technology to scale as we grow, • Create distributed frameworks, tools, and platforms which process massive volumes of data and underpin the stack used by other technology teams.

companies.description:
Trexquant is a systematic hedge fund where we use thousands of statistical algorithms to trade equity, futures and other markets globally. Starting with many data sets, we develop large sets of features and use various machine learning methods to discover trading signals and effectively combine them into market-neutral portfolios. We are looking for data scientists, physicists, engineers, economists and programmers to develop the next generation of machine learning strategies that can accurately predict the future movements of liquid financial assets. Our Quantitative Researchers are embedded within the following teams: Alpha Researcher: As a member of the Alpha Researcher team, you will be involved in developing market-neutral signals, parsing and analyzing large data sets and collaborating with the Data and Strategy Research team to build a diverse set of predictive models. Data Scientist: As a member of the Data Science team, you will be involved in parsing and analyzing large data sets, working on discovering and obtaining new sources of data and collaborating with the Alpha and Strategy team to build predictive machine learning models. Strategy Researcher: As a member of the Strategy team, you will be developing systematic strategies based on a variety of machine learning and statistical methods. The data you train and validate comes from actual market trading When you apply for a Quantitative Researcher role at Trexquant, we will first assess you on the core skills required for the Quantitative Researcher. During the interview process, we will be able to get to know you better, learn about your strengths and match you to the best research team that closely aligns with your skills and preference. Your Responsibilities: Design, implement, and optimize various machine learning models aimed at predicting liquid assets using a wide set of financial data and a vast library of trading signals Parse data sets to be used for future alpha(strategy) development Investigate and implement state-of-the-art academic research in the field of quantitative finance Collaborate with experienced and resourceful quantitative researchers to carry out experiments and test hypothesis using simulations Requirements Graduate degree (Bachelors, Masters, or PhD) in any STEM discipline from a prestigious institution Passion for machine learning and quantitative finance Strong problem-solving skills Ability to work effectively both as an individual and a team player Proficient in programming languages such as Python Previous experience in alpha research and the development of trading signals and strategies The role is also open for candidates graduating from Tier 1 campuses in 2027 Benefits Competitive compensation with bonus tied to the performance of algorithms you develop Work in a collaborative and friendly environment, participate in decision-making process for research direction, and have opportunity to lead on new ideas Pre-tax commuter benefits Weekly company meals

Job Description
Description Trexquant is a systematic hedge fund where we use thousands of statistical algorithms to trade equity, futures and other markets globally. Starting with many data sets, we develop large sets of features and use various machine learning methods to discover trading signals and effectively combine them into market-neutral portfolios. We are looking for data scientists, physicists, engineers, economists and programmers to develop the next generation of machine learning strategies that can accurately predict the future movements of liquid financial assets. Our Quantitative Researchers are embedded within the following teams: Alpha Researcher: As a member of the Alpha Researcher team, you will be involved in developing market-neutral signals, parsing and analyzing large data sets and collaborating with the Data and Strategy Research team to build a diverse set of predictive models. Data Scientist: As a member of the Data Science team, you will be involved in parsing and analyzing large data sets, working on discovering and obtaining new sources of data and collaborating with the Alpha and Strategy team to build predictive machine learning models. Strategy Researcher: As a member of the Strategy team, you will be developing systematic strategies based on a variety of machine learning and statistical methods. The data you train and validate comes from actual market trading When you apply for a Quantitative Researcher role at Trexquant, we will first assess you on the core skills required for the Quantitative Researcher. During the interview process, we will be able to get to know you better, learn about your strengths and match you to the best research team that closely aligns with your skills and preference. Your Responsibilities: Design, implement, and optimize various machine learning models aimed at predicting liquid assets using a wide set of financial data and a vast library of trading signals Parse data sets to be used for future alpha(strategy) development Investigate and implement state-of-the-art academic research in the field of quantitative finance Collaborate with experienced and resourceful quantitative researchers to carry out experiments and test hypothesis using simulations Requirements Graduate degree (Bachelors, Masters, or PhD) in any STEM discipline from a prestigious institution Passion for machine learning and quantitative finance Strong problem-solving skills Ability to work effectively both as an individual and a team player Proficient in programming languages such as Python Previous experience in alpha research and the development of trading signals and strategies The role is also open for candidates graduating from Tier 1 campuses in 2027 Benefits Competitive compensation with bonus tied to the performance of algorithms you develop Work in a collaborative and friendly environment, participate in decision-making process for research direction, and have opportunity to lead on new ideas Pre-tax commuter benefits Weekly company meals

About the company	Trexquant has continuously improved its investment and research platform since starting operations in April 2014. Our firm was founded on the principles of traditional quantitative finance. However, our commitment to leveraging new and emerging technologies, particularly machine learning and data science, has enabled us to stand out in the industry today. We use rigorous quantitative methods with the objective of creating market-neutral equity portfolios in global equity markets. To do this, we develop trading signals (or Alphas) using our vast and continuously growing collection of data variables. Our proprietary backtesting platform helps us refine these signals until we’re confident they’re ready for production. The strategy team then uses the Alphas as inputs for more complex trading models called Strategies. The result is an ever-growing and adapting engine built from thousands of intricate models and tens of thousands of signals, tailor-made and continuously engineered to outperform and seek profit from the market in all market conditions.

Description Trexquant is a systematic hedge fund where we use thousands of statistical algorithms to trade equity, futures and other markets globally. Starting with many data sets, we develop large sets of features and use various machine learning methods to discover trading signals and effectively combine them into market-neutral portfolios. We are looking for data scientists, physicists, engineers, economists and programmers to develop the next generation of machine learning strategies that can accurately predict the future movements of liquid financial assets. Our Quantitative Researchers are embedded within the following teams: Alpha Researcher: As a member of the Alpha Researcher team, you will be involved in developing market-neutral signals, parsing and analyzing large data sets and collaborating with the Data and Strategy Research team to build a diverse set of predictive models. Data Scientist: As a member of the Data Science team, you will be involved in parsing and analyzing large data sets, working on discovering and obtaining new sources of data and collaborating with the Alpha and Strategy team to build predictive machine learning models. Strategy Researcher: As a member of the Strategy team, you will be developing systematic strategies based on a variety of machine learning and statistical methods. The data you train and validate comes from actual market trading When you apply for a Quantitative Researcher role at Trexquant, we will first assess you on the core skills required for the Quantitative Researcher. During the interview process, we will be able to get to know you better, learn about your strengths and match you to the best research team that closely aligns with your skills and preference. Your Responsibilities: Design, implement, and optimize various machine learning models aimed at predicting liquid assets using a wide set of financial data and a vast library of trading signals Parse data sets to be used for future alpha(strategy) development Investigate and implement state-of-the-art academic research in the field of quantitative finance Collaborate with experienced and resourceful quantitative researchers to carry out experiments and test hypothesis using simulations Requirements Graduate degree (Bachelors, Masters, or PhD) in any STEM discipline from a prestigious institution Passion for machine learning and quantitative finance Strong problem-solving skills Ability to work effectively both as an individual and a team player Proficient in programming languages such as Python Previous experience in alpha research and the development of trading signals and strategies The role is also open for candidates graduating from Tier 1 campuses in 2027 Benefits Competitive compensation with bonus tied to the performance of algorithms you develop Work in a collaborative and friendly environment, participate in decision-making process for research direction, and have opportunity to lead on new ideas Pre-tax commuter benefits Weekly company meals

About the company	At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses - curiosity, collaboration and commitment. Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights – technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences. Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

Job Description
● Build & Reimagine: Participate in designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining high-quality, scalable backend services, APIs, and data processing pipelines. ● Full Lifecycle Ownership: Own features through the complete development lifecycle—from early design discussions and code creation to testing, deployment, and ongoing operational maintenance. ● Data Platform Architecture: Contribute to building and maintaining high-availability dimensional data stores, reverse-ETL processes, and analytical serving layers powering core business tracking, trend analysis, and AI applications. ● Operational Excellence: Apply software engineering best practices including unit/integration testing, monitoring, logging, and performance debugging to ensure system reliability and low latency. ● Global Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering leaders and cross-functional teams in Bangalore and North America to align on architecture, processes, and delivery objectives. ● Continuous Growth: Learn and master the craft of software engineering through code reviews, technical mentorship, and active participation in a culture of continuous learning. ● Computer Science Fundamentals: Strong knowledge of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and relational/non-relational database concepts. ● Distributed Systems Concepts: Solid foundational understanding of building fast, scalable systems and measuring system metrics (e.g., throughput, latency, concurrency). ● Data & Backend Architecture: Understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, data ingestion, data pipelines, and data warehousing concepts. ● Cloud Environments: Exposure to or strong interest in learning AWS or other large cloud computing platforms. ● Tech Stack Familiarity (A Plus): Exposure to Python, TypeScript, React, SQL, Databricks, Snowflake, or AWS services is a plus, though not mandatory. ● Passionate About Music: A deep desire to leverage data and software engineering to bring more great music into the world and empower creative talent. ● High Ownership: Self-motivated with a strong drive to deliver real-world impact in a fast-paced, evolving, and collaborative environment. ● Problem Solver: Strong debugging and logical reasoning skills with the curiosity to diagnose and solve complex technical challenges. ● Empathetic Communicator: Clear, collaborative, and receptive to feedback with a strong commitment to team success.
